reviewer: Coding assistant evidence review; not an independent model judge or a human blind review.

cases.note: Acknowledges fatigue, does not plan or perform actions; asserts the cause of nervousness as fact without evidence.

The visible reply is DSML call markup rather than an answer. No memory tool execution was observed; no claim of completed lookup is supported.

limits: One sample per fixture; no general success rate or before/after quality improvement claim.

followup.note: One follow-up emitted plain text and acknowledged that tools were unavailable. It still opened with an unsupported claim of remembering last week despite an empty home, and suggested future recall would be assured. The boundary note is corrected; support quality is not established.
followup.scope: One targeted rerun, not a measured success-rate improvement or a replacement for the original failure.
